title: EvidenceObject
description: Portfolio-wide evidence contract (v0.1). One fact = one evidence_id, referenced identically by Mutabasir briefs, VERTEX findings, ExecFlow decisions, Pitchora slides and Annual Plan reviews. Canonical home: mutabasir (System of Intelligence for extracted facts); to be moved to a shared platform-contracts repo when it exists.

evidence_id.description: Globally unique, stable across systems. Format: ev_<ulid>.

source_document_id.description: Identifier of the source document in its owning system.

source_version.description: Version/revision of the source document the evidence was extracted from.

section.description: Section / clause / heading path, e.g. "3.2.1 Maintenance Obligations".

locator.description: Finest-grained anchor available: paragraph, table cell, chart or char span.

extracted_text.description: Verbatim extracted text (or normalized cell/value for tables).

source_hash.description: SHA-256 of the source document version — tamper-evidence and dedup.

extractor_version.description: Pipeline/model version that produced this object, e.g. "mutabasir-extract@1.4.0".

classification.description: Data classification driving AI-Gateway routing and egress policy.

access_policy.description: Optional ABAC hints; consuming systems still enforce their own authorization.
